caption: The drawing features a single, ornate gown depicted in shades of yellow and gray against a blank, cream-colored background. The gown has a fitted bodice with a deep V-shaped front that reaches to the waist, decorated with a large gray bow and edged with lace trim. The neckline is off-the-shoulder, also trimmed with lace, with lace detailing running along the top edge. The sleeves are three-quarter length, flaring out at the ends and gathered at the elbows, with lace trim at the cuffs. The skirt is full and voluminous, extending to the floor with visible vertical folds suggesting pleating or gathered fabric. The dress is primarily yellow with shading in gray and white to suggest contour, shadow, and the highlights of the fabric. There is no visible head, hands, or lower body, and the background is plain, drawing all focus to the dress.
title: Dress
